diagram_title: Attach Explicit Net Role To Design IR

activities.title: Receive Upstream Role Assignment
activities.description: Take an explicit role assignment for a net from the schematic net-class mapping or user annotation, together with its source anchor. Never infers role from the net name.

activities.title: Validate Role Against Closed Enum
activities.description: Check the supplied role token against the closed enum (power/ground/high_current/rf/signal/differential). Unknown or absent token yields no role rather than a guessed default.

activities.title: Bind Role Provenance To Net
activities.description: Attach the validated role plus its evidence_ref source_anchor onto the Net dataclass so a checker reading the role can trace where it came from.

activities.title: Expose Role Aware Net Query
activities.description: Provide a query interface that returns only nets carrying an explicit role, letting placement-class checkers filter by role instead of by net-name heuristic.
